cases.name: Rosalyn Siobal "Rose" Glass
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Rose was born ... in Pangasinan, Philippines, she was a daughter of Mariano and Marilou (Manzanarez) Siobal. She worked at iHerb in Easton. Rose was known for her love of singing and dancing. She was a member of Grace Christian Fellowship, Bethlehem."
